title: Rhenium-186-labeled ortho-hydroxythiobenzhydrazide: a potential theranostic agent for use in metastatic breast cancer
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20241-20256
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07970E, Paper

Arpit Mitra, Avik Chakraborty, Trupti Upadhye, Sudeep Sahu, Megha Tawate, Sudipta Chakraborty, Rubel Chakravarty, K. V. Vimalnath, Somnath Kar, Dolan Sengupta, Snigdha Gangopadhyay, Sanchita Goswami, Pijush Kanti Gangopadhyay, Sharmila Banerjee
Ortho-hydroxythiobenzhydrazide was radiolabelled using [186Re]ReO4− to yield the [186Re]Re-(htbh)2 complex with high radiochemical purity, stability and targeting potential for metastatic breast cancer.
